newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil rallies strongly late in fast dealings.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil rallies strongly late in fast dealings.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures rallied strongly in late dealings and fast trading was noted in the nearby three months with fund short covering boosting prices, traders said.
"(There is) short covering in soybean oil by funds, and that's also helping the rally in beans," a trader said.
The soy complex, especially soyoil, was oversold for the near term and due for a correction, traders said.
At 1312 CDT, soyoil was 0.49 to 0.58 cent per lb higher, with July up 0.58 at 23.86 cents per lb.
